name: S09 common machine: proposed physical build

status_meaning.modelled: In the S09 numerical model with these values (read from the design state)
status_meaning.proposed: Needed to build the machine; not in any simulation. Dimensions are placeholders chosen for a plausible build, not designed

units: mm; z is the vertical lens axis, the cell's coordinates (front lens vertex at z = 0)

components.label: Cell bore
components.spec: Radius 2.02 mm between windows at z = -0.8 and +2.2286 mm; read from the design

components.label: Water / NOA 61 / water, shaped into the lens
components.spec: Interfaces drawn from the formed design state (Fig. 9b, one tone)

components.label: Two knife-edge pinning rings
components.spec: Stainless steel, 0.05 mm lip at the two lens-rim heights (the contact lines are modelled; the edges are not)

components.label: Lower transparent transducer window
components.spec: Transparent piezoelectric disc (e.g. lithium niobate) with 32 transparent ring electrodes (ITO) and radial fan-out traces

components.label: Segmented piezoceramic tube, 48 electrode bands
components.spec: PZT tube forming the bore wall; 16 silver bands per layer

components.label: Aluminium thermal housing with Peltier elements
components.spec: Holds windows and tube; two Peltier plates and a thermistor

components.label: Three PTFE fill and vent capillaries
components.spec: One per liquid layer, to syringe pumps

components.label: Flex cables, 112 channels
components.spec: From window and tube electrodes to the transmitter

components.label: Collimated test beam: LED, pinhole, collimating lens
components.spec: Below the cell on the vertical axis

components.label: Microscope objective imaging the focal plane
components.spec: The focus lies 6.43 mm above the front vertex, above the upper window

components.label: Camera and wavefront sensor
components.spec: Beam splitter cube, image camera and Shack-Hartmann sensor for closed-loop trim

components.label: Vertical optical cage and breadboard
components.spec: Four rods holding all optics coaxial with the cell

components.label: Three syringe pumps
components.spec: Set each layer to the lens's volume; final trim by optical feedback

components.label: Two-band transmitter, 112 channels
components.spec: Independent amplitude and phase per channel at 0.75 and 1.5 MHz

components.label: Control computer
components.spec: Closes the loop from wavefront to command and pumps; feedback law not designed

components.label: UV LED ring for curing (optional)
components.spec: Freezes the shaped resin; curing is not modelled

scope: Artist's impression of a proposed build of the S09 numerical machine. Only the bore, liquids and lens shape are modelled; everything else is unbuilt and unsimulated.
